title: External statutory documents
subtitle: Request and track legal invoices in a connected accounting system. ProjectFlow billing stays your management record.

separation.disclosure: ProjectFlow does not issue tax invoices. External numbers come only from a connected provider.

status.connectionRequired: Connect an external invoicing provider to request statutory documents.
status.featureDisabled: External statutory invoicing is turned off until a provider is configured.

empty.title: No external statutory document
empty.body: After SUMIT is connected, you can request a tax invoice for a finalized billing record.

reconciliation.title: Amount reconciliation
reconciliation.mismatchBanner: The invoice was issued in SUMIT but amounts do not match — review required.

settings.sumitDescription: Connect your SUMIT Test Configuration account to issue tax invoices. Production is not available in this release.
settings.testOnlyNotice: Test environment only. Do not enter production credentials.
settings.invalidCompanyId: Company ID must be a positive number.
